final:
-- Phase 2: bodies. log_line holds the io capability and no fs.

format_line(level: str, message: str) -> str =
  pre level.char_count() > 0
  post out == "[\(level)] \(message)"
  ex format_line("INFO", "started") == "[INFO] started"
  "[\(level)] \(message)"

log_line(level: str, message: str) uses io =
  pre level.char_count() > 0
  ex format_line("WARN", "disk low") == "[WARN] disk low"
  let line = format_line(level: level, message: message)
  io.print(line)
